doc.toml:
reflex = 1

description = """
Fail the database over to its replica.
Drains the primary, promotes the replica and checks that writes land on it; tells the ops channel when they do, fails back when they do not."""
not_for = ["draining the primary on its own", "checking writes on their own", "a replica that is primary already"]
tags = ["failover"]
effect = "destructive"
confirm = "Run the failover runbook?"
steps = [
  "drain connections off the primary",
  "fail over to the replica",
  "check whether writes land on the new primary",
  { say = "tell the ops channel the failover is done", when = { landing = "yes" } },
  { say = "fail back to the old primary", when = { landing = "no" } },
]

[examples]
"run the failover runbook"           = {}
"switch the database to the replica" = {}
"the primary is dying, fail over"    = {}

[tests]
"drain the primary" = {}

ok.description:
Fail the database over to its replica.
Drains the primary, promotes the replica and checks that writes land on it; tells the ops channel when they do, fails back when they do not.
not_for: draining the primary on its own
a replica that is primary already
steps: check whether writes land on the new primary

steps.say: tell the ops channel the failover is done
fail back to the old primary
